description: GRC compliance review for your pull requests. heyGRC reviews each PR against ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, the EU AI Act and your own company profile, then posts inline findings, a neutral check run, and a sticky summary. Public repos are free.

defaultPrompt: Set up heyGRC compliance review on this repository.
Install the heyGRC GitHub App and configure ISO 27001, SOC 2, and GDPR on our PRs.
How do I get compliance findings on this pull request without blocking the merge?
interface.longDescription: heyGRC reviews each pull request against the frameworks your company must comply with, grounded in your company profile. It posts inline findings, a neutral check run, and one sticky summary. This plugin does not review code locally. It walks you through installing the heyGRC GitHub App so reviews run server-side. Public repositories are free.

name: heygrc
